headline:
Earnings blowout,
valuation still reasonable
chart_note: 10-day range: $254.92 - $266.43, down 2.0% over the window - still trading above both the 50-day ($251.97) and 200-day ($238.73) averages.
why_today: Roughly flat today, holding above the 50-day average after a blowout earnings report - quarterly profit growth accelerating sharply.
pro_1: Quarterly earnings up 242% YoY on 19.6% revenue growth - a major beat
pro_2: PEG of 1.38 is reasonable given the growth reacceleration - analyst sentiment strongly positive (60 of 63 Buy/Strong Buy), price target implies ~28% upside
con_1: Still about 11% below the 52-week high ($287.20) - consolidating rather than breaking out
con_2: Beta of 1.45 means more volatility than the broader market during pullbacks
